transcript.text: Which region is the primary region? Answer with the region name.

args.sql:
SELECT c.region, SUM(o.amount) AS gross_revenue
FROM memory.bench.orders o
JOIN memory.bench.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY c.region
ORDER BY gross_revenue DESC
